title: ISC2 CISSP: Certified Information Systems Security Professional
subtitle: Trening za CISSP po ISC2 outlineu od 15. 4. 2027 (8 domena, 59 ciljeva; razlike u odnosu na outline iz 2024. su navedene): upravljanje sigurnošću i rizikom, imovina, arhitektura i kriptografija, mreže, IAM, testiranje, operacije i razvoj softvera, sa pitanjima u ISC2 stilu i CAT simulacijom.

exam.note: Pravi CISSP (engleski) je CAT: 100–150 pitanja, 3 sata, prolaz 700/1000. Outline iz 2024. važi do 14. 4. 2027, a od 15. 4. 2027 ovaj (ista struktura, druge težine domena). Za titulu treba 5 godina plaćenog iskustva u barem 2 domene (diploma ili odobren certifikat skida 1 godinu); bez toga postaješ Associate of ISC2.
exam.note_en: The real CISSP (English) is a CAT exam: 100–150 questions, 3 hours, passing score 700/1000. The 2024 outline is valid until April 14, 2027, and this one applies from April 15, 2027 (same structure, different domain weights). The credential requires 5 years of paid work experience in at least 2 domains (a degree or an approved certification waives 1 year); without it you become an Associate of ISC2.

objectives.en: Understand, adhere to, and promote professional ethics
Understand and apply security concepts
Evaluate, apply, and sustain security governance principles
Understand legal, regulatory, and compliance issues that pertain to information security in a holistic context
Understand requirements for investigation types (i.e., administrative, criminal, civil, regulatory)
Develop, document, and implement security policy, standards, procedures, and guidelines
Identify, analyze, assess, prioritize, and implement Business Continuity (BC) requirements
Contribute to and enforce personnel security policies and procedures
Understand and apply risk management concepts
Understand and apply threat modeling concepts and methodologies
Apply Supply Chain Risk Management (SCRM) concepts
Establish, maintain, and measure a security awareness, education, and training program
Identify and classify information and assets
objectives.bs: Identifikacija i klasifikacija informacija i imovine

objectives.en: Establish information and asset handling requirements
objectives.bs: Zahtjevi za rukovanje informacijama i imovinom

objectives.en: Provision information and assets securely
Manage data lifecycle
Ensure appropriate asset management (e.g., End of Life (EOL), End of Support (EOS))
Determine data security controls and compliance requirements
Research, implement, and manage engineering processes using secure design principles
objectives.bs: Inženjerski procesi i principi sigurnog dizajna

objectives.en: Understand the fundamental concepts of security models (e.g., Biba, Star, Bell-LaPadula)
Select controls based upon systems security requirements
objectives.bs: Izbor kontrola prema sigurnosnim zahtjevima sistema

objectives.en: Understand security capabilities of information systems (e.g., memory protection, Trusted Platform Module (TPM), Hardware Security Module (HSM), encryption/decryption)
Assess and mitigate the vulnerabilities of security architectures, designs, and solution elements
objectives.bs: Ranjivosti arhitektura, dizajna i elemenata rješenja

objectives.en: Select and determine cryptographic solutions
Understand methods of cryptanalytic attacks
Apply security principles to site and facility design
objectives.bs: Sigurnosni principi u dizajnu lokacija i objekata

objectives.en: Design site and facility security controls
Manage the information system lifecycle
Apply secure design principles in network architectures
Secure network components
Implement secure communication channels according to design
Manage physical and logical access to assets (e.g., provision, control, review, revoke)
Design identification and authentication strategy (e.g., people, devices, and services)
Federated identity with a third-party service
Implement and manage authorization mechanisms
Manage the identity and access provisioning lifecycle
objectives.bs: Životni ciklus identiteta i dodjele pristupa

objectives.en: Implement authentication and authorization systems
Design and validate assessment, test, and audit strategies
Conduct security controls testing
Collect security process data (e.g., technical, administrative)
Analyze test/audit output and generate report
Conduct or facilitate security audits
Understand and comply with investigations
Conduct logging and monitoring activities
Perform Configuration Management (CM) (e.g., provisioning, baselining, automation)
Apply foundational security operations concepts (e.g., Defense in Depth (DiD))
Apply resource protection
Conduct incident management
Operate and maintain detection and preventative measures
Implement and support patch and vulnerability based management
Understand and participate in change management processes
Implement recovery strategies
Implement Disaster Recovery (DR) processes
Test disaster recovery plans (DRP)
Participate in Business Continuity (BC) planning exercises
Implement and manage physical security
Address personnel safety and security concerns
Understand and integrate security in the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC)
Identify and apply security controls in software development ecosystems
Assess the effectiveness of software security
Assess security impact of acquired software
Define and apply secure coding guidelines and standards

title_en: ISC2 CISSP: Certified Information Systems Security Professional
subtitle_en: Training for the CISSP based on the ISC2 outline effective April 15, 2027 (8 domains, 59 objectives; differences from the 2024 outline are noted): security and risk management, asset security, architecture and cryptography, networks, IAM, testing, operations, and software development, with ISC2-style questions and a CAT simulation.
